mathematics.independent_solution:
正x/y且不等；前七符号依次<、<、<、>、>、=、<。第八|-x|与|-y|等于x与y，不等但大小未知；x=1,y=2给<，x=2,y=1给>。可考条件分支，不可替原文填唯一<或>。
Since x>0 and y>0, |-x|=x and |-y|=y. If x<y, the required symbol is <. If x>y, it is >. Equality is impossible because x!=y. The two branches are mutually exclusive and exhaustive over the supplied source conditions.
